content.text: The text begins with historical notes on English succession, Parliament, monarchy, and constitutional law, then shifts to poems from *India’s Love Lyrics*, emphasizing passion, loss, death, nature, and colonial settings. It next recounts a Canadian frontier narrative: settlers build Cameron’s new house in a communal “raising bee.” Smith secretly organizes the work. Cameron and Jerry investigate Indian unrest in the Sun Dance Canyon, where they discover a rebellious council. Cameron later confronts the Piegan camp, arrests Eagle Feather, and helps Mandy nurse Trotting Wolf’s son. During the rebellion, Raven, an outlaw, saves Cameron’s cattle from a deadly ravine but dies from wounds. Cameron pursues Sioux agitator Onawata through the Blackfeet and Sarcee country. War spreads after Duck Lake, yet the Mounted Police hold the western tribes from joining the rebellion. Cameron then rides toward the Ghost River and Manitou Rock to capture Onawata.
